nodes.text: In addition, they love throwing big scary-sounding words at people. Metapneumovirus is a big word. They tack on the "human" for extra effect. I notice "meta" in there. The "pneu" is a tell for pneumonia-like. "Oohh big word can't say it must be dangerous lol".

nodes.author: beat__poet
nodes.text: You just know that there'll be some Covidians, sat in their cars driving or walking from the train to work, practising saying "metapneumovirus" over and over, so they can deploy a load of "oohh've you heard?!" on their colleagues. Quintupledemic incoming. https://t.co/9hTGgEskPP
